title: The Merry Men
summary: A collection of short stories by Robert Louis Stevenson set in the Scottish islands. The title story follows a narrator's return to his ancestral home on Aros and explores themes of family legacy, superstition, shipwrecks, and hidden treasure. Other tales include 'Will o' the Mill,' which tells of a restless boy longing for adventure beyond his mountain valley; 'Thrawn Janet,' a ghost story about a haunted minister's manse; and various other narratives blending adventure, folklore, and moral reflection. The stories capture Stevenson's fascination with Scotland's rugged coasts, maritime life, and the supernatural.
